summary: Planning bot slices 1-2 plus purchase reweight and Proclaim value (#1185): BotContext.UsePlanner (default off). TurnPlan with Gold-shape purchase slate (bodies weighted up, Holdings capped by count, Proclaim value from the purchase quote); swing-based battle estimate decides declareAttack, target Province and the Gold reserved for battle tricks. Tournament arm 'planner'; champion unchanged.
validation: AI tests planner/SlateAndRebuilds and planner/SwingAttack pass. Dev smoke tournaments, 364 games each on fresh seed blocks, soundness 0 stalls/illegal/exceptions every time: slice 1 50.5%; slices 1-2 46.7%; after reweight 42.6% (p=0.005 worse); after adding Proclaim value 48.4% (176-188, p=0.56), Personalities margin -0.17, provinces margin +0.03. Smoke runs are not promotion evidence; no pre-registered decisive run done.
remaining: Not ready to merge: still no measurable gain over the champion. The planner makes ~12% fewer purchases (10.9 vs 12.4/game), proclaims ~23% less and discards ~60% more province cards; cause not found. Later slices (Action-phase sequencing, contingency branches, threat triage, post-battle replan) not built; combined pre-registration not written; check.sh not run; local only.
